label: List Group
title: List Group
summary: Use a List Group to put related list rows under one label, such as a month of payments, with one style for every row.
corePrinciple: One label, one look for every row under it.

anatomy.title: A label over rows
anatomy.description: The label sits 12 px above the rows, and the rows sit 12 px apart. The group draws nothing else: no fill, border, or padding.

configuration.title: Row style and label weight
configuration.description: List Item Style changes every row: Default rows sit 12 px apart with no fill, Boxed puts each row on a white card, and Minimal packs them 4 px apart with lighter titles. Title Level makes the label bigger and bolder. Without a label the rows start at the top.

states.title: Rows people can reorder
states.description: Give the group data, renderItem, keyExtractor, and onDragEnd, and every row gets a drag handle. People drag a row by its handle, and onDragEnd hands your screen the new order to save. All four are needed: leave one out and only the label shows. In this mode the group doesn’t pass its modes on, so give every row the same modes.

sizing.title: Full width, 12 px apart
sizing.description: The group fills its container and adds no padding: the label, 12 px, then rows 12 px apart, or 4 px with Minimal. Each row keeps its own height: 42 px for a Default List Item with an avatar, 68 px Boxed.

content.title: A label that names the rows
content.description: Write label as the one thing the rows share, such as a month or a kind of account, in a few words. It stays on one line and ends in an ellipsis; disableTruncation lets a longer label wrap.
specimen: Payments to merchants this month across all linked accounts

inContext.title: Payments, a month at a time
inContext.description: A history screen stacks one group per month, newest first. Each label names the month, and each row opens that payment.

sources.title: Use the public List Group contract
sources.description: The guide compares the Figma component with the installed package and its Storybook stories.
blocks: Installed jfs-components is 0.1.78 (27 October build of Biscuit’s main) from the team’s private package repository. Figma’s listGroup is one component: a Title over a slot of List Items, 12 px apart, drawn 352 px wide with “March 2025”. The package takes label, with none by default, and the rows as children. List Item Style and Title Level are modes, and the group passes its modes to its rows except when they can be reordered. It drops accessibilityLabel and hides the label from screen readers, so nothing names the list, and its rows aren’t list items (reported).
